title: kbsettings.py init and the first-run question disagree about the default of announce.when, and kb-setup's step writes a tracked backlog.json in the kb clone
goal: the first-run question of kb-setup and the plugin's sprint skill offers the declared default of announce.when (start,claim) as its default, and kb-setup's coordination step says what it does in the kb clone, whose backlog.json is tracked and whose own settings already run the hook, so it leaves the file as it is

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbsettings
default = ','.join(kbsettings.DEFAULTS['announce']['when'])
skills = {p: open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in ('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md', 'skills/sprint/SKILL.md')}
wrong = [p for p, t in skills.items() if re.search(r'start,claim,midrun,edit[^\n]{0,80}default|default[^\n]{0,80}start,claim,midrun,edit', t)]
setup = skills['.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md']
step = setup[setup.index('Coordination settings'):] if 'Coordination settings' in setup else ''
step = step[:step.find('\n## ', 10) if step.find('\n## ', 10) > 0 else len(step)]
clone_safe = bool(re.search(r'tracked|clone[^\n]{0,120}(skip|no hooks|already)|(skip|already)[^\n]{0,120}clone', step, re.I))
print('declared default', default, '| skills that call the wider list the default', wrong, '| kb-setup step says what happens in the kb clone', clone_safe)
sys.exit(0 if not wrong and clone_safe else 1)

clauses.clause: the first-run question of kb-setup and the plugin's sprint skill offers the declared default of announce.when (start,claim) as its default
kb-setup's coordination step says what it does in the kb clone, whose backlog.json is tracked and whose own settings already run the hook, so it leaves the file as it is

notes: Found by the SP-sucr3kfg review. The offered first option for announce.when is start,claim,midrun,edit and is called the default, while kbsettings.DEFAULTS and the doc say start,claim, so a headless run that says the defaults apply writes another value. In the kb clone, kb-setup step 8 runs init, which writes hooks coord into the tracked backlog.json and leaves it dirty, though the clone's .claude/settings.json already runs the hook without the opt-in. Plan 2026-10-24 (day run): premise reproduced on base (declared default start,claim; kb-setup SKILL.md calls start,claim,midrun,edit the default; its coordination step says nothing of the kb clone). Text edits to .claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md go through staging copies and stage-back. skills/sprint/SKILL.md line 43 offers start,claim,midrun,edit first: make start,claim the first (default) option there too. Keep init's behaviour as documented unless the clone needs it; the goal is satisfied by the kb-setup step saying what happens in the kb clone. Planned into SP-3i7hcb6i on 2026-10-24. Sprint started 2026-10-24.
